about: Product pictures and clips of Slick for the website and the README. The stills, the entries without a clip field, were captured from the launcher's own interface code drawing a made-up sample catalog over a wallpaper generated in code, at 2x on a Retina display, by scripts/ui-showcase.sh. The clips, the entries with a clip field, are recordings of the assembled app running the storyboard that field names, by make media: real search, ranking, learning, features and glass, over the same wallpaper and the same made-up app names, with opening an app recorded instead of done. Outside the live launcher app icons are plain colored squares, so the clips show those. Each clip has an MP4 for the website, a GIF for the README and a poster PNG. None shows anyone's real apps or data.

files.caption: Two typed letters find the app, and the field completes its name.
files.alt: Slick's search panel in dark mode: a slab of dark glass over a purple gradient wallpaper. The query “ca” is typed and the rest of the top result's name, “dence Calendar”, shows in grey after the cursor. Eight results follow: six apps, a Markdown file and a note command. The first row, Cadence Calendar, is selected and tagged Running. The bar at the bottom shows Open Application on Return and Actions on Command-K. The apps, files and names are made-up sample data. The picture comes from Slick's interface code running on its own, not from the finished app.

files.caption: Command-K opens the action panel for the selected result, and typing filters it.
files.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in dark mode over a purple gradient wallpaper. Typing “cad” selects Cadence Calendar, with the rest of its name in grey. Command-K opens the action panel beside the results. It lists Open, Show in Finder, Show Package Contents, Copy Name, Copy Bundle Identifier, Copy Path, Move to Trash in red and Add to Favorites, most with a keyboard shortcut. The selection moves down two entries, then typing “fav” filters the list to Add to Favorites. Return runs it, the action panel closes and the bar at the bottom shows “Added to Favorites”. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, over made-up sample apps whose icons are plain colored squares.

files.caption: Switching themes restyles the open panel at once.
files.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in dark mode with “ca” typed. The theme changes from Standard to Graphite, Ocean, Ember, Violet and back to Standard while the panel stays open, and the selection moves down a row after each change. Graphite marks the row with a flat grey fill, Ocean tints the glass blue, Ember tints it warm with a red fill and Violet uses a purple lens. The themes were switched through the theme setting. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, over made-up sample apps whose icons are plain colored squares.
